about: Kunimitsu's Tekken Tag Tournament (PS2) ending (scene 8): a duel with Yoshimitsu in the snowy forest, both strike at once (sparks at 443), Yoshimitsu falls, Kunimitsu spins her knife and leaps away in a puff (sprites at 1187). Converted by tools/ps2/ttt_to_cine.py (docs/CINE-CONVERT.md). The snowfall is the TTT stage's, not the script's: the T3 forest has none (the user's choice, 2026-10-14).

ttt_stage.why: the PS2 script's stage 19 (scene table 0x51B388), YOSHIMITSU-B in the PS2 executable (0x440670), a PS2-only variant of Yoshimitsu's stage: TTT arcade's stage 2, its only Yoshimitsu stage, snowy too but a walled garden where the PS2's is an open forest with mountains beyond: no turn matches it, yaw 0 shows the most trees (180 put the walls close behind, 2026-10-21); every TTT cinematic on its TTT stage (the user, 2026-10-21); without TTT Stages, the T3 arena 2 above

sprite_why: TTT's puff is snow (white, alpha-blended); the user wants light grey smoke (2026-10-14). On TTT stage 2 (snow, the wall and trees behind) the 1c1c1c of the T3 forest no longer showed (the user, 2026-10-21): 404040, a light puff (707070 burst white, subtracted it was black)
retarget_why: --upper-arms: with --collars alone the upper arms came out 23-25 degrees higher than the PS2's: Yoshimitsu's raised sword arm opened his armpit (530-680, Kunimitsu seen through it), her elbow stuck out in her close-up (220-240) (the user, 2026-10-21); Yoshimitsu --hips (the pelvis's turn as the PS2's) and --hand-turn 18:x:-90: his sword followed the PS2 hand's -y, its blade lies along z (stuck in the snow while he lies, 899-1439; held up instead of forward at 539-659)

actors.why: TTT costume -1 (the player's): T3 costume 0; her own head basis on her stance at 974 (session C); the arms' roll and the hands from the PS2 (--twists: rolled arms tore the mesh)
the Tekken 3 native (the user, 2026-10-14: his hands do not show in this ending) on Kunimitsu's TTT1 skeleton, his TTT1 stance; TTT costume 2: T3 costume 0
